subject: Per-customer throttles & tiering — recap + next steps
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fastcart.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Per-customer throttles & tiering — recap + next steps

Alex — thanks for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so everyone is aligned and we have clear next steps.

Pain points you called out:
- Unpredictable traffic from seasonal promotions; spikes cause noisy neighbors and blown cost targets.
- Need per-customer quotas and burst controls to protect the platform and enforce plan limits.
- Desire to route higher-tier customers to a low-latency pool and fallback lower-tier to a cached/quantized variant.

Current stack (what I heard):
- FastCart uses a managed LLM endpoint (third-party) + in-house queuing layer for request smoothing.
- Billing/usage tracked in your billing DB (Postgres) with nightly aggregation.

Success criteria you mentioned:
- Per-tenant token accounting with 99.9% accuracy for billing reconciliation.
- Enforceable per-minute and per-day quotas per customer; per-minute burst throttles for abuse control.
- Route tier A customers to a dedicated GPU pool to maintain <120ms p95 for interactive flows.

Proposed next steps (for our pilot / POC):
1) Redwood provides a short pilot config: per-tenant quotas + two routing tiers (dedicated + shared).
2) We instrument per-tenant token metrics and send a sample telemetry dump for reconciliation.
3) Legal reviews the SLA draft (attached) and you share any redlines.
4) Schedule a technical kickoff with your platform team and our SE to scope integration (30–45m).

Attachments: [Attachment: SLA-draft-FastCart.pdf (application/pdf)], [Attachment: redwood-tenant-controls-diagram.png (image/png)]

If that matches what you expect, I can: (a) create the pilot config and hubspot deal record, (b) book the kickoff for next week.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fastcart.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: platform@fastcart.com
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 17:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Per-customer throttles & tiering — recap + next steps

Thanks Stephanie — this is great, and mostly accurate. A few clarifications from our side:

- Our billing accuracy tolerance is +/- 0.5% month-over-month; daily reconciliation is fine for now but we need token-level exports for invoice audits.
- Quotas: we want both a soft quota (warning) and a hard quota (reject) at the per-day level, and a per-minute burst cap for real-time protection (e.g., 200 r/s per customer).
- Routing: Tier A customers should have failover to a warm dedicated pool (not cold start). If dedicated capacity is saturated, we want automated fallback to a quantized variant with a quality flag.

Current infra notes:
- We sit on AWS, with an API gateway -> internal queue -> LLM endpoints. The queue decouples spikes but still lets a single tenant consume disproportionate tokens.
- We can expose a sample token export (CSV) for the last 7 days once we have credentials for the reconciliation endpoint.

For next steps: please send the pilot config and a proposed kickoff window. We can do a 30-minute sync on Mon 3/29 or Tue 3/30 (PST) with our platform lead.

— Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform — FastCart
alex.johnson@fastcart.com | (617) 555-0126
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fastcart.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 18:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Per-customer throttles & tiering — recap + next steps

Alex — quick technical notes from my side based on what you described:
- We can provide per-tenant token accounting via request-level tenant_id headers and per-token attribution in logs. Exports can be streamed to S3 or pushed to your collector.
- Throttles: we support multilayered policies — per-second smoothing window, per-minute burst, and per-day hard caps. Policies are configurable via a JSON policy file and can be updated live.
- Routing: recommend a warm dedicated pool with autoscale headroom and a ‘quantized-fallback’ model tag to preserve availability.

For the pilot I propose:
- Week 0: exchange credentials + sample schema for token export.
- Week 1: deploy pilot routing + quotas in a sandbox with 2 tenants (one Tier A, one Tier B).
- Week 2: run traffic replay (you can provide traces) and validate reconciliation.

Reqs from FastCart: API key for pilot, a sample 7-day token export, and a contact for infra access (for S3/collector).

I’ll draft a minimal pilot config and post it to the Drive link Stephanie shared.

— Rishi
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
